# Alvalyn Creative

> A comprehensive illustration and design education platform offering editorial and fine art illustration services, online courses, and creative business resources.

Alvalyn Creative is run by Alvalyn Lundgren and specializes in editorial illustration, graphic design education, and fine art prints. The site combines commercial illustration services with educational courses taught at institutions like UCLA Extension and ArtCenter Extension, plus premium resources for freelance artists and designers.

## Key Topics

- Illustration services
- Editorial and publishing
- Graphic design
- Color theory
- Design fundamentals
- Fine art prints
- Creative business
- Drawing techniques
- Design education
- Advertising illustration
- Independent study
- Notan Principle
- Supply lists
- Freelance resources
- Portrait artist

## Illustration Services

- [Graphic Illustration](https://alvalyn.com/graphic-illustration): Main product page for graphic illustration services across editorial, product, and advertising.
- [About](https://alvalyn.com/about): About page detailing Alvalyn's background, credentials, and notable clients.
- [Contact](https://alvalyn.com/contact): Contact page for booking illustration projects and portrait commissions.

## Courses & Education

- [Courses](https://alvalyn.com/courses): Online courses covering design fundamentals, illustration, and creative business skills.
- [Independent Study Application](https://alvalyn.com/independent-study-application): Application form for one-on-one independent study and creative instruction via Zoom.
- [Introduction to Graphic Design Supply List](https://alvalyn.com/intro-graphic-design-supply-list): Supply list for introductory graphic design course with software and tool recommendations.
- [Fundamentals/Elements of 2D Design Supply List](https://alvalyn.com/fundamentals-elements-of-2d-design-supply-list): Supply list for 2D design course at UCLA Extension and ArtCenter Extension.
- [Elements of 3D Design Course Supply List](https://alvalyn.com/elements-of-3d-design-course-supply-list): Supply list for 3D design course taught at UCLA Extension and ArtCenter Extension.
- [Color Theory & Digital Color Gear & Supplies](https://alvalyn.com/color-theory-and-digital-color-gear-supplies): Supply list and gear recommendations for color theory and digital color course students.

## Resources & Shop

- [Store](https://alvalyn.com/shop): Online shop selling limited edition fine art prints and illustration products.
- [Premium Resources](https://alvalyn.com/resources): Premium paid resources and guides for freelance business and creative skill development.
- [Recommended Books, Supplies & Gear](https://alvalyn.com/recommended-books-supplies-gear): Curated recommendations for art books, tools, and materials for artists and illustrators.
- [Newsletter](https://alvalyn.com/newsletter): Newsletter signup offering illustration tips, design guides, and color mixing resources.

## Blog & Community

- [Eye Level](https://alvalyn.com/eye-level): Design blog featuring articles and tutorials on illustration, color theory, and composition.

## Optional

- [Copyright and Privacy Policy](https://alvalyn.com/copyright-and-privacy-policy): Legal policies covering terms of use, privacy, refunds, and copyright information.
